headline: Defense bails out Broncos in OT win as Nix, offense struggle
summary: The Broncos' D came up with five sacks, 17 QB hits and two interceptions, enabling Denver to win even though the offense finished with only 168 net yards.

headline: Seahawks' Sam Darnold owns up to late interceptions in overtime loss to Broncos
summary: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold called his two late interceptions Thursday night "unacceptable" and vowed to be better after a 17-14 loss to the Broncos.

headline: Broncos beat the Seahawks 17-14 in OT on Ja'Quan McMillian's pick, Wil Lutz's 53-yarder
summary: — The Denver Broncos are atrocious on offense, depleted on defense and shaky on special teams. All they do is find ways to win.

headline: Ryan Fitzpatrick on Bo Nix's night: "That right there is garbage"
summary: Quarterback-turned-analyst repeatedly tees off on Denver QB.
